title: Etaleness is local on the source
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $(U_b)_{b\in J}$ be a family of open subschemes of $X$ with $X=\bigcup_{b\in J}U_b$, with inclusions $j_b:U_b\to X$. Then $f$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] if and only if $f\circ j_b:U_b\to Y$ is etale for every $b\in J$ (Stacks Morphisms, Lemma 02GJ, (1)$\Leftrightarrow$(3) with the covering $Y=Y$ of the target).
